eras.source: Placement points ported from PLACEMENT_POINTS in scripts/state/evaluate_state_predictions.py / scripts/state/run_state_predictions.py. Advancement/medal-round split confirmed directly by the user: consolation-bracket wins earn 0.5 advancement (not the 1.0 that script uses for championship wins), and the four medal-deciding matches (1st/3rd/5th/7th place matches) earn 0 advancement -- only placement points apply there, to avoid double-counting a win that's already scored via placement.
eras.notes: advancement_points.medal_round_win applies to every slot in the template's placement_map (both the win-for-odd-place and lose-for-even-place match), overriding champ_win/cons_win for those specific slots only.
